cohort: The study involved 1,138 women with normal glucose tolerance (NGT) and 1,200 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).
finding: Excessive gestational weight gain (eGWG) was associated with an increased risk of large for gestational age (LGA) in both NGT and GDM pregnancies, and modified, more stringent GWG targets were associated with a lower prevalence of LGA and macrosomia delivery in GDM pregnancies.
birth_weight: Macrosomia delivery, Large for gestational age (LGA)
